- Polls /api/glassbox/integrity

Reference files:

- `workspace/glassbox/dashboard_routes.py` — the integrity endpoint (source of truth for frontend data)
- `dashboard_v2.py` — the main AtlasForge Dashboard (target for new widget)

After completing both tasks, run the full regression test suite (`pytest workspace/GlassBox/tests/test_token_integrity_pipeline.py -v`) and capture a screenshot of the updated dashboard showing the integrity widget populated with real data.

cycle_report.summary: Built a complete 5-deliverable automated token integrity monitoring system for GlassBox. All components are implemented, adversarially tested against 10 edge cases, and validated against 125 real production mission archives. A critical bug was found and fixed during testing: all three scanner components initially used the wrong manifest field path (top-level `total_tokens` instead of nested `totals.total_tokens`), which would have caused 100% false positive rates. After the fix, 115/125 missions correctly show as normal and 10 genuine historical anomalies are correctly flagged. All 10 regression tests pass.
achievements: Deliverable 1: TokenSanityCheckIntegration in af_engine/integrations/token_sanity_check.py subscribes to MISSION_COMPLETED, waits for archival, reads manifest, and warns if total_tokens < 500 (configurable threshold)

Deliverable 2: Schema validation helper _validate_mission_completed_data() added to orchestrator.py's emit_mission_completed() — warns immediately when mission_workspace, mission_dir, project_name, created_at, or started_at is None

Deliverable 3: Standalone CLI health check (token_integrity_check.py) scans all mission archives, categorizes as normal/low_token/zero_token, supports --since/--threshold/--report/--fix/--dry-run flags
Deliverable 4: /api/glassbox/integrity REST endpoint returns JSON report of anomalous missions with zero or low token counts, verified against 125 live mission archives

Deliverable 5: 10-test regression suite in test_token_integrity_pipeline.py covering full pipeline: synthetic archiving, schema validation, sanity check integration, endpoint anomaly detection, CLI scan
Critical bug caught and fixed: wrong manifest path (top-level vs nested totals.total_tokens) that would have caused 100% false positives on all 125 real missions
Adversarial test suite validates 10 edge cases: null totals, corrupted JSON, legacy flat format, boundary values (499/500 tokens), empty manifest
All 10 regression tests pass; 10 adversarial edge cases pass; live endpoint returns HTTP 200 with correct anomaly data
issues: 10 genuine historical anomalies remain in the archive (pre-fix missions from 2026-02-15 regression). rearchive_missions.py exists to recover them but was not run against all 10 — this is the primary remaining work for cycle 2.

The dashboard endpoint /api/glassbox/integrity is live but no frontend widget has been integrated into the main AtlasForge Dashboard UI at localhost:5000 — the endpoint exists as an API but is not yet visible in the dashboard's mission list view.
